<!-- uv-lifecycle-closure: execution-plan-retirement -->
<!-- uv-next-slice: legacy-direction-tool-migration -->

## Goal

Perform the mandatory D-038 context-only closure after accepted and merged PR #93 and return repository lifecycle to `idle`.

## Changes

- clear `active_slice` and set lifecycle state to `idle`;
- record `execution-plan-retirement` PR #93 merge `c8915e2aede2125136080156513ffc3bd4727038` as last completed;
- hand off to the accepted D-070 legacy direction/tool migration sequence without starting a new product slice;
- update `PROJECT_STATE.md` and `NEXT_TASK.md` for the post-merge idle handoff.

## Verification

PR #93 merged exact reviewed HEAD `01095095fbdabfdbf840063f10e968ad0c305d14` after fresh `PASS/CURRENT` with zero findings and exact-head permanent CI 5/5. This closure changes only `project-context/ACTIVE_SLICE.json`, `PROJECT_STATE.md`, and `NEXT_TASK.md`; exact closure-head permanent CI is required before merge.

## Architecture impact

None. Runtime, frontend, tests, architecture authorities, persisted project behavior and product semantics are unchanged. The closure only records accepted history and lifecycle state.

## Known limitations

This PR does not select or implement the next concrete legacy migration responsibility group. Product Orchestrator, internal Recipe Registry, legacy `/projects/{id}` compatibility, Stage8 and the `micro_drama` golden vertical remain separately scheduled work.

## Next task

After this closure merges, bootstrap from lifecycle-closed `main`, reconstruct exact live callers for legacy direction/tool composition, and choose one bounded responsibility group before opening the next product slice.
